rationale: B is better overall because it is more coherent and actionable: it connects models to concrete business decisions, includes model-specific evaluation, proposes a phased rollout, and calls for an A/B test of the ranked queue. A has greater implementation detail and a better expected-value-style deal score, but it over-engineers the initial solution and provides little validation design. Both risk target leakage, confuse deal stages with product lifecycle, and fail to model incremental revenue under sales-capacity constraints; B also should rank deals by calibrated close probability times deal value rather than probability alone.
